name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Adopt the **Claude Self-Improvement Skill Pack** to automate prompt tuning and routing. It’s the fastest way to reduce manual review cycles while improving consistency—trade-off is initial setup time and dependency on the skill pack’s reliability. The alternative, manual tuning, scales poorly and risks human error.

name: Gauge
text: The Skill Pack’s reliability isn’t guaranteed—Cerebras’ model IDs just failed, so why trust another black box? A safer path is to fork the Skill Pack, audit the prompts/engines, and run a 5% canary with strict rollback triggers; settle the argument by proving the fork’s failure rate is below 1% in staging for a week.
